## ✅ Checklist

### Code Quality
- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines

- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas

- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings

### Testing
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix/feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] I have tested on multiple browsers/devices (if UI changes)

### ZVS 2018 Compliance (if applicable)
- [ ] All Zolai text follows ZVS 2018 orthography
- [ ] No forbidden forms used (pathian, ram, fapa, etc.)

### Documentation

- [ ] I have updated CHANGELOG if needed
- [ ] I have added/updated JSDoc/docstrings

### Git
- [ ] My commits follow conventional commit format
- [ ] I have squashed unnecessary commits
- [ ] I have rebased on latest main
